issue.title: Mac CaptureRelationFlipAliasTests equals-in-editor rewrite times out waiting for the Linked-from picker under CI load
issue.description:
Observed by the bob-cli-hl.5.1 lander on bob-mac-capture tree 922561578967e4120c4d6ac5467a2d09dbe33b7d (identical tree on two SHAs):

- FAIL: master a3e533b9ec57855be534ac4d96b8bcd7cb8194bf, macOS CI run 42216904060 (2026-11-06T12:20Z):
  `CaptureRelationFlipAliasTests.swift:222: failed - Condition not met before timeout` (5.159 s) waiting for `textView.string == "New task ~~" && model.picker?.source == .linkedFrom` after typing `=` into `New task ~`.
- PASS: CI snapshot 04041733ce1334db799fa3cdf93c7c94eba8a1da (same tree), run 42212293089.
- PASS: pre-epic master 6f4e279 run 42161345004 and 9578c66 run 42209303483.

Fail rate observed: 1 of 4 recent full macOS suite runs; only in the full parallel suite on the GitHub macOS 26 runner. Not reproduced serially (no Mac XCTest available off CI). Root cause not confirmed: the wait spans a fake-bob `capture-rewrite --cursor 11` round trip plus the Links picker opening, so either a slow process spawn under load or a lost/stale rewrite reply could explain it. Check the recorded fake-bob argv and the rewrite-generation guard before raising any timeout.
